## Safety checklist

- [ ] I tested the affected route or flow on desktop.
- [ ] I tested the affected route or flow on mobile, or confirmed it is not UI-facing.
- [ ] I checked English and Arabic layouts when the change affects public UI.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks, or explained why they could not be run.
- [ ] I included Supabase migrations for database changes, or confirmed no database change is needed.
- [ ] I confirmed this PR should be deployed to production after merge.
